subject: LLM cost expectations and PO gate for BetaHealth pilot
message_1_subject: Re: Pilot follow-up — quick numbers and PO path
message_1_body:
Thanks again for the demo this morning, Marcus. Quick question for my CFO and procurement: can you give a simple estimate for expected monthly range for our pilot (we're targeting ~50M tokens/month of mixed chat + embedding traffic) and the typical PO thresholds at Redwood? Also need a single-line unit econ ($/1M tokens) to slot into our capex request. We hope to avoid a long procurement cycle if the band is below our PO threshold.

Ava
Ava Patel
Head of Product, BetaHealth
ava@betahealth.com
message_2_subject: Re: Pilot follow-up — quick numbers and PO path
message_2_body:
Great question — appreciate the clarity. Quick call recap and an apples-to-apples cost envelope for the 50M tokens/month profile you mentioned: 

- Workload mix assumption: 70% chat (short context, higher per-token compute), 30% embeddings (longer sequences).
- Recommended model: Greenwood-13B quantized (production profile we demoed).
- Unit economics we expect for that mix (baseline, no volume discounts): $15 per 1M tokens.
  - 50M tokens x $15 = $750/month (baseline).
  - Add caching and KV-prefix reuse we discussed could reduce effective cost ~10–20% depending on hit rate.

Procurement thresholds and common routing for accounts like BetaHealth: 
- Monthly <= $1,000: usually self-serve purchase or short PO (finance can sign monthly PO).
- $1,000–$5,000/month: standard PO required, procurement review but no legal SOW in most cases.
- > $5,000/month: procurement + legal review, typical lead time 2–4 weeks for enterprise terms.

Options to keep you under the shorter PO lane: 
1) Soft pilot target at 50M tokens but throttle initial month to ~35M (≈ $525 baseline) while we validate hit rates.
2) Short-term volume credit/intro pricing for the first 90 days to bring sticker below $1k if procurement is a blocker.

Next steps I propose:
- I will put together a one-page proposal with the three pricing scenarios (throttle, baseline, and intro credit) and an explicit line for $/1M tokens so your CFO can slot it in.
- Grace, can you confirm if a 10% intro credit is within scope to fast-track pilots for mid-market?

Attaching a one-page stub in the follow-up.

Thanks — talk soon.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0199
message_3_subject: Re: Pilot follow-up — quick numbers and PO path
message_3_body:
Looping in ops and discounts guidance.

Marcus — 10% intro credit is fine for a POD pilot under $10k ARR equivalent; for pilots that immediately scale to >$5k/mo we prefer a short-term commitment (30–60 days) in exchange for a larger credit.

Procurement practicalities: many customers can accept a short PO (one-pager) signed by finance for $1k–$5k/mo. Anything above $5k/mo will require standard enterprise paperwork and likely a Bay Area legal review; plan 10–20 business days.

Lauren — flag anything legal that would push lead time beyond that for a pilot SOW?

Cheers,
Grace
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: Proposal + PO guidance for BetaHealth pilot (BH-2026-007)
message_4_body:
Hi Ava — following up with a short proposal attached and the procurement guide we discussed. TL;DR:

- Baseline estimate for 50M tokens/month (70/30 chat/embeddings) = $750/month at $15 per 1M tokens.
- Conservative throttle option to stay under fast PO: target 35M tokens ≈ $525/month.
- If procurement needs sticker < $1k/mo, we can offer a 10% intro credit for the first 90 days (drops baseline to ~$675/mo).

Procurement path we recommend:
1) If finance will accept PO <= $1k — sign the one-pager PO and we can turn on pilot within 3 business days.
2) If budgeting > $1k — expect procurement PO + internal review; we can prepare a 30-day SOW to shorten legal review.

Next steps: I attached "redwood-proposal-BH-2026-007.pdf" (one-pager + price scenarios). Can you confirm which path you prefer by Friday 7/9? If helpful, I can schedule a 15-min sync with your procurement lead to remove blockers.

Quoted below is the proposal cover line for your CFO: "Pilot (30 days): baseline 50M tokens/month, unit cost $15 / 1M tokens; expected monthly spend $750; optional 10% intro credit for first 90 days."

Thanks again — looking forward to moving this to pilot.

Marcus Lin

marcus@redwood.ai
